title: Web Application Development Services

listing.shortDescription: High-performance web application development — typed end-to-end, server-rendered, accessible. Get a free project estimate.
listing.fullDescription: We build web applications that stay fast as they grow: typed end to end, server-rendered where it matters, and structured so a new engineer can find their way around in an afternoon. Performance, accessibility and observability are part of the definition of done rather than a later cleanup pass.

deliverables.title: Product architecture
deliverables.description: Data model, rendering strategy, auth model and deployment topology agreed up front.

deliverables.title: Design system and UI
deliverables.description: A reusable component library so future screens stay visually consistent.

deliverables.title: API and data layer
deliverables.description: Typed contracts, validation at the boundary, migrations and seed data.

deliverables.title: CI/CD and monitoring
deliverables.description: Automated checks on every pull request, preview environments, error and performance tracking.

useCases: Customer portals and internal operations tools
Multi-tenant SaaS products with role-based access
Rebuilds of ageing applications that have stopped scaling

faq.question: Why do you build with Next.js and React?
faq.answer: Because they hit the sweet spot of performance, hiring pool, and longevity. Server rendering keeps pages fast, TypeScript end-to-end catches bugs before users do, and you are never locked into an obscure stack that only one vendor understands.

faq.question: How do you keep the app fast as it grows?
faq.answer: Performance is part of our definition of done, not a later cleanup pass. We structure the codebase so new features do not tangle old ones, measure Core Web Vitals continuously, and optimize images, queries, and bundles as we go.

faq.question: How much does a web application cost?
faq.answer: Most business web apps land between $10,000 and $50,000 depending on features, integrations, and design needs. We scope in fixed phases so you always know what the next slice costs before we start it.

faq.question: Will our team be able to maintain it?
faq.answer: Yes. We write code a new engineer can navigate in an afternoon — typed, tested, documented — and we hand over with documentation and walkthroughs. Many clients keep us on for ongoing development, but none are stuck with us.
